joiners.name: Sanjay Konakondla
joiners.note: Transfer from Missouri-Columbia (94): PGY-3 on the Mizzou roster to 2015-07-04, gone by 2015-09-15; skonakondla@geisinger.edu on PMID 27690251 (received 2016-06). PGY5 is assumed from the 2018 graduation (credit for a prior Wayne State neurosurgery fellowship). Recorded in training_history (th_id 2525).

problems: Early rosters (2013-14..2021-22) are unobservable: the residents pages existed but Wayback and Common Crawl never archived them before 2023-03. The 2014 entry class is unresolved: the program recruited for it, but no 2014 entrant is visible anywhere. Vivekanandan's entry year and PGY path are unknown. The live site has a Radware bot check (not bypassed). The CC failures left are listed in phase2.remaining (all irrelevant paths).

2013-2014.reason: Year 1 of the program: the only resident was Mathew/Sublett (the 2013-14 program page names her as the first and only resident); no one above PGY-1 existed yet.

2014-2015.reason: 2014 entry class is unresolved. The program recruited for July 2014 (2014 page: 'residents matching this year will begin ... July 1, 2014'; the June 2014 PGY-1 orientation schedule includes Neurosurgery), but no 2014 entrant appears on any later source. Either unfilled, or a resident who left unseen, or Vivekanandan (NPI 2013, entry 2014 or 2015).

2015-2016.reason: Transfers Jayarao and Konakondla dated to 2015 (Mizzou roster + PubMed); Brimley entry 2015 (NPI). Still depends on the unresolved 2014 entrant and on Vivekanandan's entry year.

2016-2017.reason: Classes 2013, 2015 and 2016 accounted for; the 2014 class (would be PGY3) is still unresolved.

2017-2018.reason: Every entry class 2013 and 2015-2017 is accounted for by alumni and linear back-fill, and Vivekanandan is dated here by PubMed. Only an unseen 2014 entrant (PGY4) could be missing, which is the same unknown as 2014-15.

2018-2019.reason: Entry classes 2013 and 2015-2018 are accounted for (alumni list plus 2022-23 roster). Only the unresolved 2014 class remains.

2019-2020.reason: Entry classes 2013 and 2015-2019 are accounted for (Bohan, entry 2019, dated by NPI and PubMed). Only the unresolved 2014 class remains.

2020-2021.reason: Entry classes 2015-2020 are accounted for. The 2013 entrant graduated in 2020. A 2014 entrant would have been PGY7 and would appear on the alumni list, which has no 2021 graduate. The only possible unseen event is a departure before 2021, which belongs to 2014-15.

2021-2022.reason: Entry classes 2015-2021 are accounted for. Brimley and Vivekanandan are 2022 alumni, and the other five are bracketed by the 2022-23 roster at linear PGYs. The class is full (8 in a 7-slot, 1-per-year program).

2026-2027.reason: The live page (Radware bot check, not bypassed; phase-1 WebFetch) was not advanced from 2025-26. All six continuing residents were seen in 2025-26, and Bohan was PGY7.

PubMed affiliation mining 2012-2023 (Geisinger + neurosurgery; 442 PMIDs) plus per-person affiliation histories and received dates
NPPES: all Neurological Surgery NPIs in Danville PA (49) plus every resident and candidate
Cross-program checks: Missouri-Columbia residents page captures 2014-12..2015-11; Utah neurosurgery (111) and Utah general surgery rosters for Vivekanandan; Cooper/PCOM (15) roster for Okun
Geisinger news releases ('welcomes 110 residents' 2016, 'welcomes 51 advanced residents' 2017, scholarship days 2019): no neurosurgery names

CC result: 94 crawls. No residents subpage before CC-MAIN-2023-14/23 (2023-03), which confirms phase 1. The phase-1 failure CC-MAIN-2018-17 now succeeds (0 residents records). Failures on the Sitecore path in 2019-26, 2019-51 and 2022-33 were retried with ccscan_one and returned 0 records.
found: Jayarao left Mizzou between 2014-12 and 2015-06 and was at Geisinger by 2015-12. Konakondla left Mizzou in summer 2015 and was at Geisinger by 2016-06. Both are transfers in 2015.
Brimley entry 2015 (NPI 2015-04-14; Utah SOM affiliation until then)

Vivekanandan at Geisinger by 2017-09 (PubMed). NPI 2013-05-09 with a University of Utah endpoint, so she trained somewhere before Geisinger. Not on the Utah neurosurgery or Utah general-surgery rosters.
Bohan (entry 2019), Tafreshi (2020) and Richter (2021) are dated by student affiliations and NPIs, so they were back-filled as reconstructed.
The program recruited a PGY-1 for July 2014 (2014 program page; PGY-1 orientation schedule 2014 lists Neurosurgery).

Non-residents with Geisinger neurosurgery affiliations were ruled out. Okun and Stofko were PCOM/Cooper AOA residents or fellows, probably rotating (Okun was PCOM PGY5 in 2014-15). Maleeha Ahmad was an FRCS neurosurgeon, and Darren Jacobs has held a DO neurosurgery NPI since 2007. Conger, Grant, Oliver, Koul, Goren and Hendrix are faculty or fellows.
remaining: 2014 entry class: unfilled, an unseen departure, or Vivekanandan (entry 2014 with an extra year). No source names a 2014 entrant. The only evidence is negative: no PubMed author, no NPPES Danville neurosurgery NPI enumerated in 2014, and no 2021 graduate.
Vivekanandan's entry year and PGY path (rows 2017-18..2020-21 carry pgy=null)
The residents page (2016-2022) was never archived. The live site has a Radware bot check, not bypassed.

Common Crawl failures left, all on paths that did not exist at crawl time or are irrelevant: 2014-23, 2016-18, 2017-17 and 2018-05 (Sitecore path before 2018-07), 2015-18 (old /residencies/neurosurg, no residents page then), 2018-43 (news article), 2023-50 (old path, gone).
